title: Safe Around Pets
description: Most popular houseplants — pothos, monstera, peace lily, ZZ — are toxic to cats and dogs if chewed. Every plant in this collection is not. If you have a curious animal at home, start here rather than hoping for the best.

title: For Dim Corners
description: North-facing flats, internal corridors, that one corner of the living room the sun never reaches. These plants genuinely tolerate low light rather than merely surviving it for a few months before declining.

title: The Clean Air Set
description: Broad-leaved, high-transpiration plants that improve the feel of a closed room. Useful through a Delhi winter or a sealed, air-conditioned office where the windows never open.

title: Hard to Kill
description: If something has died on you before, it was probably overwatering. These plants tolerate irregular care, travel and the occasional forgotten fortnight — the right place to rebuild some confidence.

title: Always in Bloom
description: Plants grown for flowers rather than foliage, selected for long flowering windows in Indian conditions. Several of these will bloom from March straight through to October given sun and a regular feed.

title: Desk & Shelf
description: Under about forty centimetres and happy in artificial light. Small enough for a desk, a bookshelf or a bathroom sill without taking the surface over entirely.
